summary.threadTitle: Fix invoice rounding across every currency, tax mode, and export path before the v2.5 release
summary.goal: Make every invoice total, tax line, credit note, PDF, and CSV export round half-even in the currency's minor unit so the ledger reconciliation job stops flagging one-cent drifts
completed: Replaced Math.round with roundHalfEven in InvoiceTotalsCalculator and TaxBreakdownFormatter, keyed by currency minor unit
Added CurrencyMinorUnitTable covering ISO 4217 zero-, two-, and three-decimal currencies, with JPY and KWD fixtures
Moved exchange-rate snapshots behind ExchangeRateSnapshotCache so totals and exports read the same rate
Rewrote the CSV export writer to format from rounded minor units instead of floats, matching the PDF renderer
Deleted the legacy InvoicePdfRenderer rounding shim and added 23 regression cases across 9 currencies
remaining: Re-run the ledger reconciliation job against last month's production snapshot and compare drift counts
Allocate credit notes with largest-remainder rounding so split refunds still sum to the original total
Update the billing webhook payload docs to state that amounts are integer minor units

blocked.reason: EUR finalize test expects the old half-up total; needs product sign-off before changing the fixture
staging exchange-rate service returns two decimals for KWD, so the snapshot cache rejects it
read replica credentials expired; the job exits before comparing any invoices

summary.pendingQuestion: Should the EUR finalize e2e fixture change to the half-even total, or do you want product to confirm the customer-visible change first?
summary.suggestedNextStep: Ask product to confirm the half-even EUR total, then update the api-e2e fixture and re-run the ledger dry run with fresh replica credentials

note: Every array at its schema maximum, long paths and model text, and a PR with three failing jobs. Rendered in full it exceeds SQUIRE_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS, so renderSquireTurnSummary must trim model text first and elide trailing deterministic entries.
